title: About
text:
Hi! I’m Mariam El Jouzou, a graduate student at Boston University hoping to gain a profound understanding of data - from business problems to the technical analysis to the business insights and next steps.
Through my graduate studies, I’m continuing to explore new ways to apply data in a business setting.
